trial_court: I Additional Family Court, Hubballi - M.C.No.45/2022
case_name: Smt Shilpa W/O Dr Sachinkumar Kanagali vs Dr Sachinkumar Basavaraj Kanagali

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt Shilpa W/O Dr Sachinkumar Kanagali (wife)

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2018. The husband informed the wife he was not interested in the marriage and she filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The husband then filed a petition for dissolution of marriage. The wife is seeking to transfer the case to another court.

legal_principles.principle: When two petitions are pending in different courts, the court may transfer one of them to another court for efficient disposal.
legal_principles.held: Since both the matters are pending consideration within the jurisdiction where the wedding was conducted and where the petitioner/wife is residing, the only question that requires to be considered is whether the petition filed by the respondent/husband should be transferred to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Hubballi.

legal_principles.principle: A petition filed as an afterthought to counter another petition may not be given priority.
legal_principles.held: Petition in M.C.No.45/2022 filed by the respondent/husband is an after thought only to counter the petition filed by the petitioner/wife.
use_in: cases where a party files a petition in response to another's

outcome.final_order: The petition was allowed and the case was transferred to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Hubballi.

use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of family court cases
